decision: Create a stiffer, lower-modal-order four-channel candidate before spending the remaining physics evaluations. c2’s open-loop trials showed that its main failure is not tension authority: terminal positions were already within 14–39 mm and M5 position within 14 mm, but gravity-driven transients produced 0.46–0.71 m/s holding speeds and 0.085–0.115 m/s tendon speeds. Maximum legal Young’s modulus and section dimensions should suppress the initial gravity excursion, while six cells per segment reduce unresolved high-frequency modes; maximum routing radius preserves control authority. A zero-state mechanics query will verify stiffness, gravity loading, channel signs, and clearances before controls are evaluated.
evidence: On c2, M1_B and M1_C respected both stroke bounds despite useful lateral and vertical motion, and M5 ended at [0.2947,-0.0262,0.1331], close to its target [0.29,-0.025,0.12]. Nevertheless, all four latest evaluations failed geometric tendon speed, with peaks 0.0852–0.1148 m/s, and the reach holding speeds were 0.461–0.714 m/s. The observed trajectories had their largest gravity sag around 0.14–0.30 s and then rebounded, demonstrating underdamped structural dynamics. Earlier c2 mechanics reported only 0.428–0.701 Nm/rad cell stiffness. The new sections and E=15 MPa are expected to raise bending stiffness several-fold while retaining the same 0.298 m straight-tip geometry and four independent polar channels.

The M5 target axis [0.966,-0.174,-0.193] is consistent with roughly -y/-z constant-curvature bending. Equilibrium outputs are expected to identify final constant tensions that can then be approached with smooth ramps and a terminal hold.

decision: Generate a fourth two-segment, four-tendon candidate that preserves the useful c3 geometry but materially increases bending stiffness and, especially, structural damping. The c3 terminal poses were close—M1_C passed terminal position and M5 missed position by only 0.97 mm—but all reach trials exhibited 0.42 m/s holding transients and tendon speeds 0.068–0.110 m/s. A more damped structure is therefore higher leverage than further endpoint-amplitude tuning. Maximum routing radius improves moment authority so the stiffer beam should remain reachable within 8 N.
evidence: On c3, M1_A/B/C holding speeds were 0.4268/0.4223/0.4254 m/s despite directionally correct endpoints; M5 terminal speed was already 0.0260 m/s and its endpoint was close. Stroke extrema stayed within about ±0.0077 m, leaving ample ±0.015 m margin. The proposed moderate stiffness increase and approximately order-of-magnitude viscosity increase are expected to suppress gravity/control oscillations while the 0.023 m tendon radius preserves bending authority.
